name: deskling-relay
description: Deskling relay: connects your AI agents to your Deskling desk screen.

DESKLING_TOKEN.description: A password of your choosing that your agents and your Deskling screen use to talk to this relay. Make it long and random, e.g. run `openssl rand -hex 24`. Keep it somewhere safe: you'll paste it into the screen and the Claude Code plugin.

FIRMWARE_URL.description: Where firmware updates come from. Leave as is unless you publish your own builds.
